fields.baseline: ENERGY STAR qualified equipment for listed appliance categories; demand controlled kitchen ventilation requires variable speed motors controlled to vary fan speed depending upon kitchen demand as indicated by connected sensors; anti-sweat heater controls must reduce anti-sweat heater energy consumption based on sensing humidity
fields.methodology: Prescriptive per-unit incentives paid by equipment type/category when the unit meets the listed ENERGY STAR or control-based efficiency requirement. Demand controlled kitchen ventilation exhaust hoods are paid at $0.15/kWh of annual energy savings, and anti-sweat heater controls are paid per linear foot of case length.
fields.minp: Equipment must meet or exceed the listed minimum efficiency requirement for its category; commercial dishwashers limited to high temperature models with electric boosters; ice machines air-cooled only; demand controlled kitchen ventilation and anti-sweat heater controls are retrofit only; electric combination oven 3–40 pans
fields.notes: 1. Equipment that meets or exceeds the efficiency requirements listed for the equipment category may qualify for the listed incentive. 2. Refer to Rocky Mountain Power's Wattsmart Homes program for efficiency requirements and incentives for listed residential appliances used in a business. 3. Incentives are paid at $0.15/kWh annual energy savings; demand controlled kitchen ventilation exhaust hood energy savings subject to approval by Rocky Mountain Power. See Appliances section for additional incentives. CEE = Consortium for Energy Efficiency; MDEC = Maximum Daily Energy Consumption; V = AHAM Volume (cubic feet).
fields.rate: Commercial dishwasher (high-temperature models w/electric boosters only), ENERGY STAR qualified: under counter $100; single tank stationary (door type) $300; single tank conveyor $500; multiple tank conveyor $500. Electric insulated holding cabinet, ENERGY STAR qualified: V ≥ 28 (double size) $1,000; 13 ≤ V < 28 (full size) $600; V < 13 (half size) $400. Electric steam cooker, all sizes, ENERGY STAR qualified: $600. Electric convection oven (full size or half size), ENERGY STAR qualified: $350. Electric fryer (width < 18 in standard or ≥ 18 in large), ENERGY STAR qualified: $300. Electric griddle, all sizes, ENERGY STAR qualified: $300. Electric combination oven, 3–40 pans, ENERGY STAR qualified: $700. Ice machines (air-cooled only), ENERGY STAR qualified: harvest rate < 500 lbs/day $125; harvest rate ≥ 500 lbs/day $150. Demand controlled kitchen ventilation exhaust hood (retrofit only): $0.15/kWh annual energy savings. Anti-sweat heater controls (retrofit only): low-temp (freezing) cases $20/linear foot (case length); mid-temp (refrigerated) cases $16/linear foot (case length). Residential dishwasher, refrigerator and freezer used in a business: see offering in Schedule 111 (Wattsmart Homes program).
fields.tiers: Dishwasher: under counter $100 / single tank stationary $300 / single tank conveyor $500 / multiple tank conveyor $500. Holding cabinet: V ≥ 28 $1,000 / 13 ≤ V < 28 $600 / V < 13 $400. Ice machines: < 500 lbs/day $125 / ≥ 500 lbs/day $150. Anti-sweat heater controls: low-temp $20/linear foot / mid-temp $16/linear foot.
fields.value: $100–$1,000 per qualifying ENERGY STAR food service unit
